meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你操作 Git 历史或回答 Git 相关问题，比如提交代码、改写提交历史、查找谁改了某行代码、恢复误操作等。它会先检查仓库状态，再按你的要求执行，并给出详细报告。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、改写提交历史、查看 Git 历史（如谁改了某行、何时添加的）或检查仓库状态时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交当前所有改动，提交信息用英文祈使句。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动，按原子提交分组并提交。

say.text: 最近三次提交是谁做的？分别改了哪些文件？
把最近两次提交压缩成一个，保留第一个的提交信息。
say.note: Claude 会执行 rebase 并检查结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you operate on Git history or answer Git-related questions, such as committing code, rewriting commit history, finding who changed a line, or recovering from mistakes. It inspects the repository state, executes your request, and provides a detailed report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit changes, rewrite commit history, inspect Git history (e.g., who changed a line, when something was added), or check repository status.

say_en.text: Commit all current changes with an English imperative commit message.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes, group them atomically, and commit.

say_en.text: Who made the last three commits and what files did they change?
say_en.note: Claude will use git log and git show to provide details.

say_en.text: Squash the last two commits into one, keeping the first commit message.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a rebase and verify the result.
